tagline: Leading domestic tank barge operator for bulk liquid transportation
hero_kpi_rationale: Kirby is the largest inland tank barge operator in the United States, with dominant transportation capacity reflecting its structural leadership in the bulk liquid marine transportation sector.

kpis.name: Inland Tank Barge Capacity
kpis.explanation: Capacity for transporting bulk liquid products on the Mississippi River system and inland waterways
kpis.description: Kirby Corporation is the largest inland tank barge operator in the United States, operating 1,105 inland tank barges
kpis.signal: Significant capacity for bulk liquid transportation, reflecting market leadership

kpis.name: Coastal Tank Barge Capacity
kpis.explanation: Capacity for transporting bulk liquid products along the U.S. coastlines
kpis.description: Kirby Corporation operates 28 coastal tank barges with a total capacity of 2.9 million barrels
kpis.signal: Complementary coastal capacity for bulk liquid transportation

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Total workforce supporting marine transportation and distribution services operations
kpis.description: Kirby Corporation has approximately 5,233 employees, the vast majority based in the United States
kpis.signal: Large workforce reflecting the scale of domestic operations

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has variable-rate credit facilities, making it vulnerable to interest rate fluctuations. A 1% increase in interest rates could impact interest expenses by approximately $1.2 million.

risks.title: Fuel Price Volatility Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fuel price fluctuations, which can impact its costs and profit margins. Fuel price escalation clauses in contracts may not fully offset increases.

risks.title: Asset Impairment Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company holds significant assets, such as marine transportation equipment (barges and tugboats), which may be subject to impairment. A significant impairment of these assets could materially affect financial results.

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may be involved in litigation or legal proceedings arising from its marine transportation operations, which could impact financial results and reputation.

risks.title: Environmental Incident Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may be affected by safety incidents or environmental issues in its marine transportation operations, which could impact financial results and reputation.

risks.title: Environmental Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to stringent environmental regulations in the marine transportation sector, which may impact its operations and financial results.

risks.title: Adverse Weather Conditions Risk
risks.score_rationale: River and coastal operations are vulnerable to adverse weather conditions such as floods, low water levels, tropical storms, hurricanes, and lock closures.

ai_positioning.summary: The company KEX has no significant mentions related to artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided excerpts from its 10-K filing.
